jobs.occupation: Design for Value & Cost Engineer – from concept to competitive edge, GN Hearing, Ballerup hos ReSound
jobs.description:
Are you ready to apply your engineering, project leadership and sourcing expertise to the world of product development and manufacturing? Join us as Senior Project Manager in Design for Value (DfV) and impact the way we design, develop, and manufacture products at GN Hearing in Ballerup.

The Team You Will Be Part Of

Based at our global HQ, located in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join the Design for Value team in Global Manufacturing & Operations, reporting directly to Director René Bergqvist.

In this role, you will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders worldwide, ensuring value and cost are managed effectively and optimized in our products from the early concept phase through to mass production.

Your Contribution Is Appreciated And You Will

• Optimize products by supporting the organization with cost / value analysis in our products, modules, platforms and architecture

• Investigate and motivate for cost-effective design and manufacturability, e.g. via mapping of value / cost opportunities related to roadmap, product, and design options

• Manage cost targets and running estimate for ramp up in development projects

• Facilitate and support project sourcing activities including availability reviews, supplier selection, RFQs, and negotiations

• Support building positive business cases together with R&D & Product Marketing

• Facilitate and conduct project reviews related to Design for Value, Cost and Manufacturing

• Follow up and guard the cost in product development by working with R&D on their suggested specification, manufacturing or material selection

You will also work on introducing new technologies and innovations during product development and play a key role in approving targets and results before critical milestones are passed.

You will also support key cross-functional projects that are part of strategic initiatives (“must-win battles”) with significant value or savings impact from an Operations and Sourcing perspective.

Role

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you - besides having a technical mindset and a good business understanding - have:

• A degree or similar within engineering, preferably within electronics

• Experience within platform and product development, supplier sourcing or cost/value optimization in a R&D environment are positive differentiators

• Good at solving both technical and commercial issues

• General understanding of manufacturing processes and industrialization

• Experience with LEAN, Design for Value/Cost, or supplier sourcing in Asia, are positive differentiators

• Presentation, negotiation, and communication skills in English, both written and spoken

In addition, you have an engaging personality and possess facilitation skills, enabling you to build networks and engage stakeholders. You also possess solid analytical and problem-solving abilities, which you use to identify issues and propose effective solutions.

You are, furthermore, steadfast and enjoy working in a multicultural, changing environment. You take initiative and, most importantly, follow through on the initiatives you start.

We Offer

• A unique opportunity to grow and gain experience across both engineering and business

• A supportive and dynamic work environment where you can learn to navigate change with confidence

• Opportunities for professional and personal growth in a top-tier global high-tech company.

• The chance to contribute meaningfully to GN

• An international and collaborative workplace

We encourage you to apply

We highly value a mindset, motivation, and energy, that align with our core values, to not only ensure your growth, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the Interview please let the hiring manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 25 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our leading intelligent hearing, inspired by people and driven by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We help people with hearing loss overcome real-life challenges, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.occupation: QMS Professional for CMC Pilots Engineering
jobs.description:
QMS Professional

CMC Pilots Engineering

Location: onsite Bagsværd

**Your impact begins here

**Would you like to work closely with quality, engineering, and projects in a highly collaborative and technically complex environment? We are looking for a QMS Professional to join CMC Pilots Engineering and support quality and compliance activities across the department. In this role, you will work closely with engineers, scientists, technicians, QA, and managers to help ensure quality, structure and coordination of projects.

This role offers broad exposure across the organisation and an opportunity to work with quality processes in a dynamic environment with many stakeholders and ongoing activities. Apply today!

**What You’ll Do

**As QMS Professional in CMC Pilots Engineering, you will support and coordinate quality activities across the department, including follow-up on deviations, CAPAs, audits, and training, while contributing to continuous improvements and alignment across teams. The role combines operational coordination, stakeholder collaboration, and quality support, and suits someone who enjoys working across functions and building strong relationships in the organisation.

**Your Day-to-day Tasks Will Include

**

• Coordinating and facilitating weekly quality board meetings, including follow-up on actions and deadlines

• Supporting handling and follow-up on deviations, CAPAs, and change requests across projects and teams

• Supporting preparation and coordination of audits and inspections together with relevant stakeholders

• Monitoring quality data and supporting visibility on quality-related activities and deadlines

• Collaborating with engineers, scientists, QA, and leaders on GMP and QMS-related topics

• Supporting onboarding and training activities related to deviations, quality processes, and systems

• Contributing to continuous improvements of quality processes and ways of working across the department

You will succeed in this role if you enjoy creating structure, connecting the dots across quality activities and turning data into clear insights that help the organisation focus on what matters most.

**Who You’ll Work With

**CMC Development turns promising molecules into approved products in close collaboration with colleagues across Research & Development and Global Manufacturing & Supply.

CMC Pilots Engineering is part of CMC Pilots and is responsible for engineering activities related to pilot facilities and manufacturing of new drug substance and product candidates. The department consists of more than 70 employees working across projects, validation, and technical development activities.

**What You’ll Bring

**We image that you hold a master’s degree in engineering, biotechnology, chemistry, pharmacy, or similar. You also bring:

• At least 3 years of experience working with GMP and quality processes in a regulated environment

• Hands-on experience with deviations, CAPAs, audits, training coordination, or related QMS activities

• Experience using the Test Information Management System (TIMS), will be considered an advantage

• A structured and proactive approach, and comfort following up on tasks and deadlines

• An interest in quality processes and continuous improvements

Experience from engineering, pilot production, validation, or pharmaceutical development environments will be considered an advantage.

As a person, you take initiative, work proactively, and can handle multiple tasks at once. You enjoy collaborating across teams and working with many stakeholders. You keep an overview in hectic situations, see possibilities, and drive solutions.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued, and your contribution can shape decisions across markets. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership. You will be encouraged to make your voice heard, learn from colleagues and contribute to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases. We foster a collaborative culture where we care for one another, value initiative, and empower you to drive projects forward while growing professionally.

**What We Offer

**Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 570,200 to DKK 838,100, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives and other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Please apply by 29 November 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Associate Director Anne Krogh Rovik at AERV@novonordisk.com .

While not mandatory, we strongly encourage you to submit a cover letter explaining why you are the ideal candidate to join us in CMC Pilots Engineering. Please do not include a photo in your CV, as this supports a fair and efficient recruitment process.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

_**

**Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

Your key responsibilities will be to:

And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. Stibo DX is the company behind Cue, our multimedia enterprise platform used by media organizations around the world to create, manage, and deliver content across digital and print channels.

As Cue evolves from self-hosted and hybrid deployments towards a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform, the way our platform connects, exchanges data, and governs information is becoming increasingly important. Creating greater consistency across APIs, integrations, events, schemas, and data ownership is therefore one of our key architectural priorities.

As our Senior Integration & Data Architect, you will take ownership of shaping a more unified, governed, and decoupled integration and data architecture across Cue. You will help us tackle fragmentation and inconsistency across the platform and establish clear architectural patterns that enable our product and engineering teams to build and evolve solutions with greater speed and confidence.

This is very much a hands-on architecture role. You will not simply define principles and governance from a distance. You will work directly with teams on real designs, APIs, event contracts, integrations, schemas, and data domains, helping translate architectural direction into solutions that work in practice. You will work with modern architectural approaches and technologies such as API-first design, GraphQL/REST, Kafka, CDC, schema evolution, and multi-tenant SaaS.

You will become part of a small, but senior architecture team with significant autonomy, visibility, and responsibility. Working closely with our Platform Architect, who focuses on runtime, multi-tenancy, and observability, and our Senior Software Architect, who focuses on domain boundaries and solution design, you will have the opportunity to influence how the entire Cue platform develops as we continue our SaaS transformation.

You will report to the Director of Solution Architecture, and you will work within an architecture governance model keeping decisions close to the teams, while applying the right level of architectural guidance based on risk. The role can be based at any of our offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Oslo, Málaga, or Hamburg, depending on where you are located.

Key responsibilities

• Define and govern the unified API strategy for CUE (REST and GraphQL), design standards, versioning, deprecation, breaking-change discipline, and consistency across teams.

• Design integration patterns for a modular, microservices-based platform, sync vs async, anti-corruption layers, adapters, and migration from bespoke customer integrations to standardized platform interfaces; guide teams on when to use events vs APIs and how to avoid tight coupling.

• Own event-driven architecture on Kafka, topic design, event contracts, schema evolution, CDC/streaming, and consistency models (ordering, idempotency, replay).

• Establish data domains and governance, ownership models, schema definition and evolution, metadata, lineage, quality, classification, retention, and compliance readiness.

• Align contracts with domain boundaries, connect bounded contexts, domain events, and service ownership to API, event, and data design, in close collaboration with the Software Architect.

• Enable teams through architecture leadership, produce reference architectures and integration blueprints, shepherd ADRs, review high-risk designs, and coach teams on better patterns without blocking delivery.

• Reduce fragmentation and drive consolidation, identify one-off approaches early and steer teams toward reusable platform standards.

• Partner across architecture and delivery, work with platform, product, and engineering teams to ensure standards are usable, adopted, and durable.

What you will bring

You are someone who naturally takes ownership and looks beyond individual solutions to understand what is best for the platform as a whole. You notice fragmentation, inconsistencies, and emerging risks, and you are proactive in bringing people together to find practical ways forward.

You are comfortable working across engineering, architecture, and product, and you know how to turn complex integration and data topics into clear, pragmatic decisions that teams can actually work with. You build credibility through your expertise, but also through collaboration, listening, and an understanding that strong architecture needs to support delivery rather than slow it down.

You believe in strong standards where they matter, while taking a pragmatic, risk-based approach to governance. You are curious and adaptable, care about quality and maintainability, and are motivated by creating clarity around contracts, data ownership, and architectural boundaries. Ultimately, you enjoy bringing coherence to complex platforms and leaving them in a better architectural state than you found them.

Experience

• 10+ years in software engineering, integration engineering, data engineering, or architecture, with 5+ years in a senior role focused on integration, APIs, events, and/or data architecture.

• Proven experience designing and governing APIs in large, distributed, multi-team environments.

• Strong experience with REST and GraphQL API design, versioning, and contract-first approaches.

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture in production, preferably Kafka.

• Experience with integration patterns: messaging, pub/sub, request/reply, outbox, saga/process manager, and CDC.

• Strong understanding of schema modeling and schema evolution for APIs and events.

• Experience defining data domains, ownership models, and data governance in a product or platform context.

• Ability to connect Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts (bounded contexts, domain events, aggregates) to integration and data design.

• Understanding of AWS, Kubernetes-based platforms, and multi-tenant SaaS implications for data isolation and integration boundaries.

• Security-aware design across APIs and events, authentication, authorization, zero-trust principles.

Interested?

Please apply here on LinkedIn. You are encouraged to apply at your earliest convenience. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview. Applications are processed as they are received until the right candidate is found.

Should you have questions about the position, you are also welcome to contact Director, Safdar Aqeel via mail safs@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

Help us empower storytellers across the globe

jobs.description:

**

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track). The positions are with the department's research groups located at the university campus in Copenhagen.

Your profile and work tasks
We seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.

The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Cyber security
• Privacy engineering
• Computer Systems
• Edge/cloud computing
• High-Performance Computing (HPC)
• Data Engineering
• Big Data Infrastructure
• Machine Learning Systems
The main tasks and responsibilities include:

• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
• participating in grant application activities
• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment
Your competencies
You have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we are
In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. 

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. 

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

Tenure-track
When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

• The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
• The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
• The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
• The candidate is a skilled communicator
• The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
• The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process
Evaluation and promotion proces:

• Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.
• A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.
• A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.
• Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship 
Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship
The assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

• Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
• Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
• Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
• The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
• The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 
If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
• References/recommendations 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

 Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

• Build connectors that collect data from third-party systems, usually ERPs, mainly by consuming their REST APIs, and bring it reliably into our platform.

• Understand the data you collect and transform it into Trackunit's data model.

• Work with third-party vendors: discuss technical feasibility and approaches with their technical counterparts.

• Build with quality, observability and reliability in mind, on our microservice and event-driven architecture.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

jobs.description:

Do you have the experience, leadership skills and commercial mindset needed to deliver some of Europe’s most strategic energy infrastructure projects? And can you lead multidisciplinary teams? Then, come join COWI!  **Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Peter Malmkjær, Head of Projects, Green Energy Pipelines at PRMR@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you applyAll you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. Equal opportunity employerCOWI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. jobs.description:
**Location: Copenhagen (please note this job requires onsite presence - remote work not possible)

**Do you want to work hands-on with modern cloud-based technologies, data engineering and AI, while helping turn complex data into solutions that create real business value?

Join us as a Data Engineer to become part of an environment where knowledge is shared, and curiosity is encouraged. And work with tools such as Snowflake, dbt, Claude, Microsoft Azure, SQL and AI as you help develop the data platform that enables actionable insights, intelligent solutions and data-driven applications.

“You’ll get to contribute to solutions for a wide portfolio of customers - without compromising on flexibility and work-life balance. This also allows you to develop your expertise through challenging assignments and collaboration with experienced colleagues,” says Brian Landbo, Manager, SmartX.

**Join an environment built around knowledge, collaboration and growth

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe that development happens when people learn and solve challenges together. You will become part of our ambitious and agile SmartX team where the pace is high and where we work with modern cloud technologies, data engineering, analytics and AI through our data platform.

**Develop our cloud-based data platform

**As a Data Engineer, you will work closely with analysts, developers and business stakeholders, play a central role in developing our cloud-based data platform, and help transform complex data requirements into robust solutions that deliver real value. You will work across data engineering and AI, while contributing to the foundations that make intelligent and data-driven solutions possible.

**More Specifically, You Will

**

• Develop and maintain data models

• Develop, optimize and quality-assure data pipelines in Snowflake

• Implement transformations, tests and documentation using dbt

• Ensure high data quality through automated testing and validation processes

• Work with Medallion Architecture and modern data warehouse principles

• Support the development of AI-based solutions and data-driven applications

**Experience With The Main Technologies

**You do not need to tick every box. We believe some of the best colleagues grow through curiosity, commitment and a genuine desire to learn. We are looking for a new colleague who enjoys solving complex problems and who is motivated by both technology and the value it can create. You thrive in a collaborative environment where professional dialogue and knowledge sharing are an important part of everyday work. And you enjoy continuously learning and exploring new technologies within data, AI and cloud platforms.

**Finally, We Imagine That You

**

• Have hands-on experience with and a solid understanding of Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse

• Have strong SQL and data modelling skills, including experience with dimensional modelling such as facts, dimensions and star schemas

• Have experience using dbt for data transformation and ETL/ELT processes

• Have worked with data validation, automated testing and documentation

• Have experience with Git and agile development processes

**Ready to build what comes next?

**Then we are happy to hear from you and urge you to hit that “Apply Now“ button.

Apply today and make NTT DATA Business Solutions the place where you grow.

**Job Description

**Do you want to lead a team of six and shape the future of data and analytics in Danica? As Head of Business Data & Analytics, you will develop people, set direction and strengthen the link between data, insights and business value.

Your team works across business and data analytics, partnering with the business and management to turn complex challenges into actionable insights and data-driven solutions. Data is a key enabler of Danica’s strategy: your work will support better decisions, customer experiences, business performance and growth. This role combines people leadership with a strong interest in data and business, helping the team and wider organisation strengthen their use of analytics as our capabilities evolve.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will strengthen analytical maturity and continuously develop our data and analytics capabilities. As our new data platform evolves, you will leverage opportunities enabled by the platform, AI and other emerging technologies to improve how we generate insights and turn data into tangible business value.

Your team will be a trusted business analytics partner to stakeholders across Danica, providing insights that enhance business decisions.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop a team of six, helping them turn data and analysis into actionable business insights.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Danica, acting as a trusted analytics partner while providing credible professional challenge.

• Continuously develop the team's analytical capabilities, methods and ways of working, fostering a strong analytical mindset and high professional standards.

• Collaborate with the leadership team in Data & Analytics to set direction, align priorities and strengthen how data and analytics create value across Danica.

**About You

**We imagine that you are an experienced people leader with a strong background in analytics, data or a closely related field. You do not necessarily need to be the deepest technical specialist in the team, but you should have sufficient analytical understanding to challenge, guide and develop the team.

• People leadership. You have demonstrated leadership experience and enjoy developing people. You lead with trust, curiosity and a collaborative mindset.

• Analytical expertise. You bring strong analytical expertise and act as a trusted sparring partner for the team.

• Business understanding. You understand how business questions can be translated into data use cases, analysis and actionable insights.

• Direction and delivery. You are able to set direction while balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day delivery.

• Stakeholder relationships and communication. You build strong stakeholder relationships and are comfortable constructively challenging established thinking. You communicate complex topics clearly and confidently across technical and non-technical audiences.

It is required that you are fluent in both Danish and English !

**What We Offer You

**

• Influence and impact. Shape the future of Business Data & Analytics in an area where data increasingly drives business development and decisions. Develop the team’s analytical competencies and influence how new data capabilities create business value across Danica.

• Leadership development. Genuine opportunities to develop your own leadership capabilities.

• Hybrid working. Hybrid working arrangements, typically three days per week in the office.

Interested**?

**Apply today! If you have any questions about the position, please reach out to the Head of Data & Analytics Thomas Jonsson at thjon@danica.dk . We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply at your earliest convenience.

We look forward to hearing from you!
